stories.title: Multiple bomb threats made to Oahu schools, no credible threats found
stories.summary: Multiple O’ahu schools received calls with bomb threats on Wednesday.

stories.title: ‘The Night Between’ invites guests to save Christmas in Kakaako
stories.summary: A new holiday-themed immersive experience is coming to Kakaʻako this month, inviting guests of all ages to help save Christmas.

stories.title: AARP says changing economy left Social Security funding plan behind
stories.summary: Lawmakers confront the reality that the must shore up Social Security funding before the program heads off a fiscal cliff.

stories.title: Arson investigation underway after fire damages Sunset Beach park pavilion
stories.summary: According to a preliminary investigation, an unknown suspect set fire to a bench inside a pavilion near the park’s public restrooms.

stories.title: Maui commission hears hours of testimony about police chief
stories.summary: The Maui Police Commission will review investigations and other matters involving Chief John Pelletier, including a request to reinstate him from paid leave.

stories.title: Skateboarders welcomed to Hanapepe Town Park after opening of $1.68M skate park
stories.summary: Find your bearings – the newly constructed skate park at Hanapēpē Town Park is officially open for skateboarding, the Department of Parks and Recreation announced Tuesday.

stories.title: Military housing project at Marine Corps Base Hawaii halfway constructed
stories.summary: The upgraded so-called “Bachelor Enlisted Quarters” will have modern amenities for 380 single marines and sailors.

stories.title: Kapiolani Community College celebrates 80 years of education, career opportunities
stories.summary: The college, located near Diamond Head, offers a wide range of programs, including health sciences, culinary arts and other career-focused fields.

stories.title: Girl, 11, sentenced for rape, assault of 5-year-old
stories.summary: An 11-year-old Cleveland girl has been ordered to spend at least seven years in the juvenile system for her role in the attack on a 5-year-old girl.

stories.title: Power blip causes systemwide water service interruptions for thousands in South Carolina
stories.summary: A South Carolina public water utility issued a systemwide boil water advisory Wednesday after a service interruption.

stories.title: Murphy’s Bar & Grill holds 15th annual Turkey Tailgate for families in need
stories.summary: “We just want to be part of the community and give back because the community has been so good to us,” Owner Don Murphy said.

stories.title: Paramedic mom unknowingly responds to scene where son was crushed to death while working on car
stories.summary: A paramedic in Utah unknowingly responded to an emergency involving her son after a car he was working on fell on him, authorities said.
